exceptions.justification: braces is only a link in the dependency path to braces, which carries advisory GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (braces: stack exhaustion through deeply nested brace patterns). braces is used for glob expansion inside markdownlint-cli2, run over this repository's own files.
exceptions.alternatives: Replace the tool that pulls it in; the only fix npm offers is a downgrade of markdownlint-cli2 to 0.0.4; the secretlint chain no longer reaches it after the secretlint 13 upgrade.
exceptions.attempted: Ran `npm audit fix` and checked for a newer release of each direct dependency in the path; none removes the advisory without a downgrade.
exceptions.constraint: No patched braces exists in the range these tools depend on.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade as soon as a patched release exists; the dependency-pin-sync and Dependabot updates will propose it.
exceptions.residualRisk: Exploiting it needs an attacker-controlled glob pattern with deeply nested braces; these tools only ever process this ecosystem's own repository files and run in CI or on a developer machine, never as a service.
exceptions.revisitWhen: A patched release of the affected package is published, or the tool is replaced.
exceptions.ruleBroken: SecurityDeps: no unresolved high-severity npm audit finding in what the package installs.
exceptions.whyPreferable: Dropping the linter, secret scanner or licence checker would remove a contract check for every package; the exposure below is theoretical.
